description: Declaration of the polar_decoder_impl class implementing a polar code decoder based on TS38.212 specifications, including internal structures, node processing methods, and initialization routines.

classes.name: polar_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a polar code decoder using SSC algorithm, supporting node types and internal state management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with input data, LLRs, code size, and frozen set.

methods.name: rate_0_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_0 node, setting bits to zero.

methods.name: rate_1_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_1 node, making hard decisions on bits.

methods.name: rate_r_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_R node, combining child node outputs.

methods.name: simplified_node
methods.description: Handles node processing based on node type for SSC decoding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Performs decoding of input LLRs into data bits using the polar code.
